description: Check navigation or category labels. Give `labels` (one per line or comma separated). Flags catch-alls (Resources, Solutions, Misc), labels over 4 words, 'X and Y' labels, instruction words, all capitals, trailing punctuation, filler suffixes (hub, center, zone), duplicates and one-letter-apart near-duplicates, groups of labels with overlapping scope from a built-in set (support/help/contact, news/blog/press, products/solutions/services and others), mixed verb-led and noun labels, and mixed Title Case and sentence case. Wording checks only; test labels with people.

labels.description: Labels, one per line or comma separated
